field.aliasName: case when isnull(d.tk_ts, '') = '' then a.tk_vt else d.tk_ts end

field.name: gt_kh_ky_nt
field.aliasName: case when isnull(d.so_ky_kh, 0) = 0 then 0 else a.tien_nt/d.so_ky_kh end

field.name: gt_kh_ky
field.aliasName: case when isnull(d.so_ky_kh, 0) = 0 then 0 else a.tien/d.so_ky_kh end

declare @departmentCode varchar(32) = '', @departmentName nvarchar(128) = '', @currencyName nvarchar(128) = '' select top 1 @departmentCode = @ma_bp, @departmentName = ten_bp%l from dmbpts where ma_bp = @ma_bp if @departmentCode = '' select @departmentCode = @ma_bp_ex, @departmentName = @ten_bp_ex select @currencyName = ten_nt%l from dmnt where ma_nt = @ma_nt
if exists(select 1 from dmttndts where ma_pl_ts = @ma_pl_ts and status = '1') begin select '' as array$, &Fields.Data.Client.Alias; from dmttndts a with(nolock) join dmploaits z with(nolock) on a.ma_pl_ts = z.ma_pl left join dmplts b with(nolock) on a.loai_ts = b.ma_loai left join dmtgts c with(nolock) on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmtk d with(nolock) on case when a.tk_ts = '' then @tk_no else a.tk_ts end = d.tk and d.loai_tk = 1 left join dmphi f with(nolock) on a.ma_phi = f.ma_phi left join dmnv g with(nolock) on a.ma_nv = g.ma_nv left join dmtk h with(nolock) on a.tk_kh = h.tk where a.ma_pl_ts = @ma_pl_ts and a.status = '1' return end else begin select '' as array$, &Fields.Data.Client.Alias.Empty; return end

query.text:
&CheckRelativeProcess;
declare @c char(1), @d char(1), @unitKey nvarchar(4000), @q nvarchar(4000), @key nvarchar(4000) select @c = char(253), @d = char(252) select * into #t from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@@queryString, @c)
declare @customer varchar(128), @voucherCode char(3), @dateFrom smalldatetime, @dateTo smalldatetime, @unitCode varchar(8000), @separateCodes char(1), @idNumber char(13) = '' declare @maximumAllowedNumber int, @faAccounts varchar(4000), @accountKey nvarchar(4000)
declare @bcRoundAmount int, @fcRoundAmount int select @bcRoundAmount = val from options where name = 'm_round_tien' select @fcRoundAmount = val from options where name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
select @dateFrom = data from #t where id = 1 select @dateTo = data from #t where id = 2 select @voucherCode = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 3 select @customer = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 4 select @unitCode = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 5 select @separateCodes = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 6 select @idNumber = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 7
if @unitCode = '' set @unitCode = @@unit
select @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('m.ma_dvcs', @unitCode, @@userID, @@admin)
select @faAccounts = val from options where name = 'm_ds_tk_tscd' select @maximumAllowedNumber = val from options where name = 'm_dong_td_tscd' select @maximumAllowedNumber = isnull(@maximumAllowedNumber, 1)
if @voucherCode = 'PN1' begin select top 0 tk into #data$tktscd from dmtk0 exec dbo.FastBusiness$App$GetAccountKey 'a.tk_vt', 'inlist', @faAccounts, '#data$tktscd', @@userID, @@admin, @accountKey output end
select top 0 identity (int, 1, 1) as id, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, cast(null as nvarchar(4000)) as ten_vt, cast(null as varchar(32)) as ma_pl_ts, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_vt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp as ma_bp_gl, a.ma_kho into #d from d71$000000 a right join (select top 0 null a) b on 1 = 0 select top 0 identity (int, 1, 1) as line_nbr, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_vt, cast(null as nvarchar(4000)) as ten_vt, cast(null as varchar(32)) as ma_pl_ts, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_vt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp as ma_bp_gl, a.ma_kho into #detail from d71$000000 a right join (select top 0 null a) b on 1 = 0
declare @$table varchar(32), @field varchar(4000) = '', @join varchar(4000) = '' select @$table = case when @voucherCode = 'PNA' then '71' when @voucherCode = 'PNB' then '72' when @voucherCode = 'PNG' then '78' else '31' end
if @voucherCode = 'PN1' select @field = 'a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, '''' as ma_vt, a.dien_giai, '''' as ma_pl_ts, a.dvt as dvt, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_vt, '''', a.ma_bp, '''' as ma_kho' else select @field = 'a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, ' + case when @@language = 'v' then 'b.ten_vt' else 'b.ten_vt2' end + ', b.ma_pl_ts, b.dvt, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.tk_vt, '''', a.ma_bp, a.ma_kho', @join = ' join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and b.loai_vt = ''71''' select @key = 'a.so_luong > 0' if isnull(@idNumber, '') <> '' select @key = @key + ' and a.stt_rec = ''' + replace(@idNumber, '''', '''''') + '''' if isnull(@accountKey, '') <> '' select @key = @key + ' and ' + @accountKey
-- Collect raw data select @q = 'insert into #d select ' + @field + ' from d' + @$table + '$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @join + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @@userID, @@admin
if @separateCodes = '1' begin -- Split data by quantity ;with wn as (select row_number() over (order by (select null)) as n from sys.all_objects), ws as ( select n, t1.*, case when n.n < @maximumAllowedNumber then 1 when n.n = @maximumAllowedNumber then t1.so_luong - (@maximumAllowedNumber - 1) else 0 end as so_luong_moi from #d t1 join wn n on n.n <= t1.so_luong ) insert into #detail select ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ten_vt, ma_pl_ts, dvt, so_luong_moi as so_luong, round((tien_nt/so_luong) * so_luong_moi, @fcRoundAmount) as tien_nt, round((tien/so_luong) * so_luong_moi, @bcRoundAmount) as tien, tk_vt, ma_bp, ma_bp_gl, ma_kho from ws where so_luong_moi > 0 order by stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, n ;with wmax as (select max(line_nbr) line_nbr, stt_rec, stt_rec0 from #detail group by stt_rec, stt_rec0), wsum as ( select sum(tien_nt) as tien_nt, sum(tien) as tien, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, wmax.line_nbr from #detail a join wmax on a.stt_rec = wmax.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = wmax.stt_rec0 and a.line_nbr < wmax.line_nbr group by a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, wmax.line_nbr ) update #detail set tien_nt = d.tien_nt - c.tien_nt, tien = d.tien - c.tien from #detail a join wmax b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr join wsum c on a.line_nbr = c.line_nbr join #d d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = d.stt_rec0 end else begin insert into #detail select ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ten_vt, ma_pl_ts, dvt, so_luong, tien_nt, tien, tk_vt, ma_bp, ma_bp_gl, ma_kho from #d order by stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr end
update #detail set ma_bp = b.ma_bp from #detail a join dmbpts b on a.ma_bp_gl = b.ma_bp0 where b.status = 1 and a.ma_bp_gl <> '' --
declare @queryWhereClause nvarchar(4000), @queryFormClause nvarchar(4000), @$status char(1) set @$status = '2' select @queryFormClause = 'm' + @$table + '$%Partition m with(nolock) join #detail a on m.stt_rec = a.stt_rec left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmttndts d on a.ma_pl_ts = d.ma_pl_ts and d.status = 1' select @queryWhereClause = 'm.status = ''' + replace(rtrim(@$status), '''', '''''') + ''' and m.stt_rec not in (select stt_rec_gl from zcctdkts where ma_ct = ''TS1'')'
if @unitKey is not null select @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + case when @queryWhereClause = '' then '' else ' and ' end + @unitKey if @customer <> '' select @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + case when @queryWhereClause = '' then '' else ' and ' end + ' m.ma_kh like ''' + replace(rtrim(@customer), '''', '''''') + '%''' if @voucherCode in ('PNA', 'PNB', 'PNG') begin if exists(select 1 from syssiterights r where r.user_id = @@userID) begin select @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + case when @queryWhereClause = '' then '' else ' and ' end + ' exists(select 1 from syssiterights r where r.user_id = @@userID and a.ma_kho = r.ma_kho)' end end
&FilterInitialize;&FilterQuery; declare @partitionKey nvarchar(4000), @l int, @firstItem varchar(128), @lastItem varchar(128) select @firstItem = @@firstItem, @lastItem = @@lastItem, @partitionKey = 'convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec + replace(str(a.line_nbr, 5), '' '', ''0'')' select @l = 21 + character_maximum_length from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'wrkcolumns' and column_name = 'so_ct'
if @firstItem <> '' set @firstItem = left(@firstItem, @l) + replace(str(right(@firstItem, len(@firstItem) - @l), 5), ' ', '0') if @lastItem <> '' set @lastItem = left(@LastItem, @l) + replace(str(right(@lastItem, len(@lastItem) - @l), 5), ' ', '0')
exec FastBusiness$Partition$ExecutePage @@refresh, @@pageIndex, @@pageCount, @@lastPage, @@lastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @@textExternal, @queryFormClause, @queryWhereClause, @@textOrderBy, @partitionKey, 'm.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @unitCode, @@admin, @@userID
